descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says look at, examine, or inspect an object under/with a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Find the object, then turn on the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for simple single-object tasks: "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a/an X in/on Y". No heating, cooling, cleaning, lamp, or count of two.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the object must be cleaned/washed first ("clean", "clean X", sink/water implied) then placed, e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet". Uses sinkbasin.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the object must be cooled first: words cool, cold, chilled, chill, refrigerate ("put a cold apple on the table", "cooled lettuce"). Uses fridge, then place.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the object must be heated first: words heat, hot, warm, cook, microwave ("put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat the mug"). Uses microwave, then place.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task has two or a plural count of the same object: "put two pillows on the sofa", "two/both/2 X in/on Y". Find and place two separate objects.
